query:
SELECT rp.user_id,
                  u.display_name AS "display_name?",
                  rp.external_email,
                  rp.role AS "role!",
                  rp.response AS "response!"
           FROM fms.reservation_participants rp
           LEFT JOIN fms.users u ON u.id = rp.user_id
           WHERE rp.reservation_id = $1
           ORDER BY rp.invited_at
